description: Prepared, not admitted: the 18 collaborative workflow families of DL-090 and DL-091 with the final registry row each own Storage admission landing will append. A prepared row is denied by the admission path, absent from Plans/event_family_registry.json and unable to advance a projection checkpoint (DL-046's rule for prepared rows, applied by analogy as the coordination preparation did).
admission_rule: A family moves to admitted_static_contract only in its own Storage admission landing, one family per landing, after its own blind form-driven review, with the registry row byte-equal in canonical JSON to registry_row, its registry_row_sha256 recomputed by the DL-077 recipe, its own Decision Log entry and DL-077 admission record, and an authority_contract_ref naming this ledger row.

activation_preconditions: record_family_registered: the owner record the producer commits is a registered Storage family in the event's scope (DL-090; CW section 12)
